work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Brief CLXXV ends the apostolic visitation of the Roman archconfraternity of the Annunciation and prescribes its councils and dowry nominations; across running titles LF38828 and LF38896, own provenance LF38893 and page number 265 LF38962; complete 19 June 1838 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF38810–38810; the source closing at LF38968–38971 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die decima nona iunii mil- lesimo octingentesimo trigesimo octavo, pon- tificatus Nostri anno octavo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
